name: mgdetailing-web
description: Web de MgDetailing: landing y turnos (frontend React) + API (backend Node).

scripts.instalar: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n backend,frontend -c red,gray "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.verificar: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend test && npm --prefix frontend run build
